editorial.blurb: Txa Txa Club is a bright, thoughtfully designed café that nails presentation and hospitality, with an eclectic menu of vegetarian-leaning pastries, coffee, and cocktails.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the sandy (breakfast sandwich) without hesitation—reviewers rave about its lemongrass-punchy pork patty and beautiful execution, though portions are petite, so plan accordingly.

topDishes.note: beautifully presented egg and pork with lemongrass punch
thoughtfully plated with citrus and squid ink drizzle
divisive but photogenic—citrus-forward with marshmallow frosting
